text: Here's what shipped in Larkwork since yesterday.
Twelve changes merged, from five builders. Three are worth knowing.
One. Shift swaps without the back and forth.
Before, you asked your manager, waited, and they edited the rota by hand.
Now you post the shift, a colleague takes it, and your manager approves it in one tap.
Two. Hours by team, on one page.
Open Reports, then Hours, to see every team's week next to its budget.
Reminders now go out in each clinic's own time zone.
Exports keep the order you sorted by.
And a rota with a gap names the empty shift. That one ships with the next release.
That's the day. Most of this is live now, in version 4.18.
